name: TG_TAG Telegram Bot
description: A multi-purpose Telegram bot with AI, media, utility, and database features.

ADMIN_ID.description: Numeric Telegram user ID for the bot administrator.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional OpenAI API key for image generation.

ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.description: Optional ElevenLabs API key for multilingual voice cloning and speech.

ELEVENLABS_MODEL.description: ElevenLabs model used for multilingual speech.

ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID.description: Optional ElevenLabs premade voice ID for /tts.

AGENTROUTER_API_KEY.description: AgentRouter API key for the /ai command.

ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Anthropic-compatible AgentRouter token used by /ai when configured.

TERMUX_WS_URL.description: TG_TAG WebSocket hub URL used by the Termux AI worker and /ai command.

TERMUX_AI_MODELS.description: Comma-separated Termux model fallback order used when a model quota is exhausted.

TELEGRAM_API_ID.description: Telegram API ID from my.telegram.org for folder analysis.

TELEGRAM_API_HASH.description: Telegram API hash from my.telegram.org for folder analysis.

TELEGRAM_SESSION.description: Telethon StringSession generated by /session. Keep secret.

GMAIL_ADDRESS.description: Optional Gmail address for the admin email feature.

WEBHOOK_URL.description: Public HTTPS base URL of the Heroku app, for example https://your-app.herokuapp.com.

LIVE_MAX_MINUTES.description: Maximum duration for a livestream recording. Defaults to 180 minutes.

YOUTUBE_LISTENER_CHANNEL.description: YouTube channel monitored by the listener worker.

YOUTUBE_LISTENER_CHAT_ID.description: Telegram chat ID receiving new YouTube uploads; defaults to ADMIN_ID.

YOUTUBE_AUTO_UPLOAD.description: Upload detected videos to the authorized YouTube channel. Disabled by default.

YOUTUBE_UPLOAD_PRIVACY.description: Privacy for automatic uploads: private, unlisted, or public.

YOUTUBE_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth client ID for the destination YouTube channel.

YOUTUBE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Google OAuth client secret for the destination YouTube channel.

YOUTUBE_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: Google OAuth refresh token for the authorized destination YouTube channel.
